name: p6_cine_dry
description: Phase 6 test: a noise crack and a wood body with rattle 0.4 at 1.0 s, no exaggeration layers. -30 LUFS.

name: p6_cine_hit
description: Phase 6 test: p6_cine_dry plus a riser into the hit (0.9 s, 300 to 3000 Hz) and a subdrop under it (90 to 30 Hz). -30 LUFS.

name: p6_crate_plain
description: Phase 6 test: a wooden crate panel (modal wood, f0 180 Hz) hit by a noise burst, no rattle. -30 LUFS.

name: p6_crate_rattle
description: Phase 6 test: the same crate with rattle 0.6 (a buzz while the ring is loud). -30 LUFS.

name: p6_lid_glide
description: Phase 6 test: the same lid with strike_glide 80 cents (the pitch starts sharp and settles with the level). -30 LUFS.

name: p6_lid_plain
description: Phase 6 test: a metal lid (modal membrane, f0 300 Hz) struck once, no glide. -30 LUFS.

name: p7_lid_new
description: Tonality test, round 3: the lid with modal noise 0.85 (now real noise bands), noise_width 0.5, tilt 6, strike_glide 35. Rounds 1-2 had no noise at all (the glide dropped it: fixed). -36 LUFS.

name: p7_lid_old
description: Tonality test: a metal lid (modal membrane f0 300, 128 modes, strike_glide 35) struck by an impulse, as before. -36 LUFS.

name: p7_plank_new
description: Tonality test, round 3: the plank with modal noise 0.6 (now real noise bands), tilt 4, loss 1.8. -36 LUFS.

name: p7_plank_old
description: Tonality test: a wood plank (modal wood f0 180, loss 1.2) hit by a noise burst, as before. -36 LUFS.

name: p8_latch_new
description: Click latch with noise 0.75, set by the listener: a plausible small plastic or metal part. Peak -6 dBFS.

name: p8_latch_old
description: Tonality test: a click latch (size 0.6, hardness 0.8) as it was (voiced 0.60). Peak -6 dBFS.

name: p8_step_wood_new
description: Tonality test, round 2: wood step, weight 0.4, noise 0.35 (0.6 felt slammed), scuff 0.6 (the roll), creak 0.5 (the board). Peak -6 dBFS.

name: p8_step_wood_old
description: Tonality test: a default footstep on wood (voiced 0.84 at 158 Hz). Peak -6 dBFS.

name: p8_step_wood_soft
description: Wood step, round 3, softer: weight 0.25, ring 0.6 (the board's decays x0.6), noise 0.35, scuff 0.2, no creak. Peak -6 dBFS.

name: slam_a
description: Phase 0 A: the round-0 agent door slam, rebuilt as it was; output set to -28 LUFS for the listening test.

name: slam_b
description: Phase 0 B: layered synthetic door slam with a bus chain and room, tuned by search against two CC0 references (mean STFT distance 10.08 dB). -28 LUFS.

name: slam_b2
description: Phase 0 B2, after the listening notes: dry and mono, atonal noise weight (no sine), wood modal excited by noise, friction brush before the hit, wood-on-wood knock instead of the metal latch/rattle. Search-tuned; brush held at -10 dB. -28 LUFS.
prompt: B still sounds a bit too melodic like a tuned drum; the real door is atonal, weightier and snappier; SFX should be dry; real recording has a subtle frictional sound before the hit; the second hit sounds like a chime or rusted metal, not wood on wood.

name: slam_c
description: Phase 0 C: recorded slam (Freesound 571797, CC0) pitched down plus synthetic sub, latch, bus chain and room, tuned by search (9.49 dB). -28 LUFS.

name: slam_real
description: Phase 0 control: the unprocessed CC0 recording (Freesound 571797), -28 LUFS. Its distance to the two scoring refs is 10.40 dB.
